channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japanese municipalities with over 5% foreign nationals up more than twofold
item.description: The internal affairs ministry data show increases in foreign populations not only in major cities and industrial districts but also in rural areas.

item.title: Lawmakers split on including nuclear submarine study in security documents
item.description: "I think the public understands the need for discussions" on Japan's possession of a nuclear submarine, Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi said.

item.title: BOJ is said to lean against back-to-back rate hike in October
item.description: The BOJ officials see little need for consecutive rate hikes in the absence of signs that upside inflation risks will increase abruptly.

item.title: Japan and U.S. review troops’ off-duty rules after Okinawa killing
item.description: Crimes including rapes, assaults, hit-and-runs and drunk driving by U.S. military personnel have long triggered protests in Okinawa.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
